reviews.title: awesome airline
reviews.text: this aircraft was very clean inside and out. the staff were very professional and nice. the seats were comfortable with enough leg room for an airline. the seats were clean and trays were spotless. the food was very tasty and fresh. I liked it. everyone on board was nice, helpful, and professional in every manner. I was very impressed with everything. I will definitely recommend this airline from Afghanistan and will also try to fly it myself whenever the opportunity arises.
reviews.author: Azin D

reviews.title: How it should be done
reviews.text: Internal flight in a Fokker jet. Huge legroom and very comfortable seat. Best view of mountains that I have ever had from a plane. The snow covered Hindu Kush mountains make this flight a great ride. Breakfast was good, cake biscuits and a drink and tea coffee and water whenever you wanted. Cabin crew could not be better chatting to several passengers who were regulars on this flight. Arrived on time and went straight out the airport. Security is very tight on these flights which is reassuring.
reviews.author: Nich W

reviews.title: Dubai to Kabul Commute
reviews.text: They get you there. And back. All that matters really for this route. Try to think of other more exotic Safi destinations as you fly this route because it makes the time pass more quickly. It is better than the Fly Dubai express flight though and is more on time.
reviews.author: DDV

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: I have frequently flown between Kabul and Islamabad through Safi Airways and found their service as reasonable. The flights are on time. Although flight duration is only 45 minutes but the snacks offered include a cold sandwich, which is not good.
reviews.author: Arif K

reviews.title: Great service into the 9th Century
reviews.text: Good service on te relatively shirt flight from Dubai into Kabul. Safi compares very well with other carriers flying in this region of the world. The cabin staff deliver service that used to the norm in this world of declining standards of in-flight service.
reviews.author: Great-Flying-Owl

reviews.title: Buy the pilot a watch
reviews.text: I have tended to prefer Safi, despite the fact that their frequent flyer bonuses are rather disorganized. (Send us your boarding passes and we'll give you a free ticket.) However, it really is time that they buy the driver a watch, and also learn to tell people what is going on. Their late departures from Kabul seem to be standard, but not as predictable as the complete failure to share any information with those who have bought a ticket, in particular on the ground. This doesn't need much money, if any. But it does need a change in mindset.
reviews.author: TheJockDiplomat

reviews.title: Ok value for money.
reviews.text: Strange way to end boarding with buissnes class. Comfortable seats but quite old planes. Meals ar quite good, better than expected. They do not serve any alcohol ofcourse. Service is ok too.
reviews.author: LL1961
